clue.text: Dairy product produced by fine Greek character

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil grades or penalty notices
eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A cheese made from a Greek letter-like recipe: a dairy item produced by a fine Greek person.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is a brined white cheese, and cheese is a product of the dairy.

clue.text: How crabs move, and fish among rocks

indicators.note: the fish is placed among the letters of the swaying word, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: rocks as a verb means sways from side to side
the ide is a freshwater fish, a favourite of crossword setters

explanation.surface: A seashore scene: crabs scuttling one way, fish darting between the rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabs famously scuttle laterally, moving to the side rather than forwards.

clue.text: Recently stolen piece of angling equipment in fast car

parts.note: hot is slang for stolen goods still being sought by police
a fishing rod is the angler's main tackle

explanation.surface: A thief speeds off in a quick car with a freshly pinched fishing rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot rod is a car modified for high speed and acceleration.

clue.text: Bribes had worked, protecting knight in prison

indicators.note: protecting means the rearranged letters wrap round and shield the knight's letter
worked suggests the letters are kneaded or shaped into a new form

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: Bribery succeeded and a knight was shielded from jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worked' rearranges BRIBESHAD into BEHIDBARS; 'protecting' then puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being behind bars is the idiom for being locked up in jail.

clue.text: Quiet formal announcement following end of weather forecast

indicators.note: following means the announcement comes straight after the letter from weather

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for playing quietly

indicators.note: end of means the final letter of the word weather is taken

parts.note: an edict is an official proclamation or decree

explanation.surface: A hushed official statement after the weather bulletin ends.
explanation.definitionFit: To forecast is to foretell what will happen, a direct synonym as verbs.

clue.text: Resentment of crown voiced

indicators.note: voiced means the word is spoken out, so we want a word that sounds the same

parts.note: the crown of a hill is its top or summit, a peak

explanation.surface: Someone bitter about a royal crown, the grievance spoken aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Pique is a fit of wounded pride or irritation, a kind of resentment.

clue.text: Footman is out and about just after that in play

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the time word
out signals the letters are put out of order

parts.note: then means next, immediately after that

explanation.surface: A footman leaves and wanders around just after a scene in a stage play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' gives TIMONOFAS; 'about' wraps it round the time word, splitting off the final S. Shakespeare's title hides behind 'Footman'.
explanation.definitionFit: Timon of Athens is a Shakespeare tragedy about a generous Athenian who turns misanthrope.

clue.text: Finished first in that Open?

parts.note: over means ended or done

indicators.note: first in means the opening letter of the word that is taken

explanation.surface: A golfer finished first in the Open championship, the question asks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Open' poses as the golf championship but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means done openly, not hidden or secret.

clue.text: Mother lost small flask

indicators.note: lost suggests the letters have gone astray and wandered into a new order

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Mum mislaid a little drinks flask.
explanation.definitionFit: A Thermos is a vacuum flask that keeps drinks hot or cold; the brand stands for the type.

clue.text: Conservative directly opposed

explanation.surface: A Tory politician standing in flat opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Square means both unfashionably conventional and face-on or directly, as in square against something.

clue.text: Disciplinarian's point in trading centre

indicators.note: in places the point within the trading centre's letters

parts.note: a mart is a market
a tine is a prong or point of a fork or antler

explanation.surface: A strict figure making their point inside a busy market.
explanation.definitionFit: A martinet is a strict enforcer of rules, named after a stern French drillmaster.

clue.text: Held back in reserve, and groomed

parts.note: groomed in the sense of prepared or coached, as a candidate is

explanation.surface: A sports substitute kept on the bench, but well prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Restrained describes something kept in check or curbed, a synonym for held back.

clue.text: Drink first drop of malt whisky, say, for morale

parts.note: tea is the national drink

indicators.note: first drop of means just the opening letter of malt

parts.note: whisky is an example of a spirit, signalled by say

explanation.surface: A bar-room toast: a drink and a drop of malt whisky to lift spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Team spirit is a group's shared enthusiasm and confidence, its collective morale.

clue.text: Titled lady enthralled by high-powered American

indicators.note: enthralled by means held captive inside the following words

explanation.surface: An aristocratic Englishwoman captivated by a powerful American.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a Dame holds the female equivalent of a knighthood.

clue.text: Notices form provided is about European father

parts.note: a school form is a class
if means on condition that, provided

indicators.note: about means the word is goes round the following letters

parts.note: taken as written
dad is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Form-filling about a European father, if conditions allow.
explanation.definitionFit: Classified ads are short paid notices in a newspaper, grouped by category.

clue.text: Farce enjoyed involving artist breaking into church

indicators.note: breaking into means the inner letters force their way inside the church's

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: involving means the first word wraps around the artist

parts.note: had, as in had a good time, means enjoyed
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: A burglary by an artist into a church, enjoyed as a farce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' makes HARAD, and 'breaking into' sets that inside the church abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is an absurd pretence, a farce put on for show.

clue.text: Service still good around noon

indicators.note: around means the letters for still and good go round the letter for noon

parts.note: even so means nevertheless, still
N stands for noon, as in the twelve o'clock mark

explanation.surface: A church service is still good, round about midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is evening prayer in Anglican worship, a church service.

clue.text: Get through? I don't know

definitions.meaning: to succeed in an exam, to make the grade
said by a quiz contestant declining a question

explanation.definitionFit: Pass means both to succeed in a test and, on a quiz show, to decline to answer.

clue.text: Vexatious English gang returned to squeeze different ones

indicators.note: to squeeze means the turned letters press round the different ones inside
returned means the English gang is read backwards

parts.note: a mob is a gang or crowd
others means different ones, the rest

explanation.surface: An English gang comes back to lean on a different group of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' gives BOME, and 'to squeeze' has it hold the different ones in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bothersome causes irritation or annoyance, much as vexatious does.

clue.text: Wasted opening in brilliant game

indicators.note: opening in means the first letter of brilliant

parts.note: lotto is a game of chance like bingo

explanation.surface: A wasted chance: a missed opening in a brilliant match.
explanation.definitionFit: Wasted is slang for very drunk, and blotto is another informal word for it.

clue.text: Guys eating most of blue fruit

indicators.note: eating means the word for guys swallows the trimmed sad word

parts.note: men means guys

indicators.note: most of means the final letter of the word for blue is dropped

parts.note: blue means depressed or low in spirits

explanation.surface: Men eating most of a blue fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims blue (sad) to LO, and 'eating' puts that inside the guys. 'blue' looks like a colour for the fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A melon is a large juicy fruit of the gourd family.

clue.text: Singer in pub, Italian individual

parts.note: a bar is a drinking place, a pub
IT is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A singer performing in a pub, an Italian on his own.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer whose voice lies between tenor and bass.

clue.text: Just son given hint

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son in genealogy
to imply is to hint or suggest

explanation.surface: A boy was given only a clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Simply and just both mean merely or only, as in simply a matter of time.

clue.text: Atmosphere caused by raising catastrophe

indicators.note: raising in a down clue means the word is lifted to read from the bottom up

parts.note: doom means ruin or disaster

explanation.surface: An atmosphere created by heightening the sense of disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Mood is the prevailing feeling or tone of a place, its atmosphere.

clue.text: Live way out guarding head of state

indicators.note: guarding means the way out surrounds and protects the letter

parts.note: an exit is a way out

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of state

explanation.surface: A live exit route kept guarded for the head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: To exist is to be alive, a synonym for live as a verb.

clue.text: Star, depressed when the day is done?

parts.note: the sun is a star
down means low in spirits, depressed

explanation.surface: A celebrity feeling low at the end of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Sundown is sunset, the time of evening when daylight ends.
